task1.title: Request for a Letter of Recommendation
task1.prompt: You are applying for a new job and need a letter of recommendation from your former employer. Write a letter to your former boss requesting this letter. In your letter, you should: explain why you are applying for the new job, mention any relevant skills or experiences that you would like highlighted in the recommendation, and provide your former boss with details on how to submit the letter.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In recent years, technology has significantly changed the way we communicate. Some people believe that this has led to better communication and understanding, while others argue it has caused misunderstanding and isolation. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on the impact of technology on communication.
